traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet. This combination is modern/cyclic only.

modern.blend: Emotional life meets disruption and the need for freedom. Feelings turn unpredictable, restless, and resistant to routine.
modern.harmonious: Emotional independence and a quick, inventive instinct; at ease with change.
modern.hard: Emotional volatility, sudden moods, and a recoil from anything that feels confining.
modern.business: Good for inventive moves and breaking stale routines; poor for steady, predictable handling.

cyclicNote: This pair runs a full conjunction-to-conjunction cycle; waxing/waning phase meaning is carried on the transit entries.
sourceNote: Composed from planet primitives, not the pair cookbook (which omits Uranus-Moon/Mercury/Venus).

provenance.modern: composed from planet primitives and modern outer-planet conventions; cookbook omits these pairs
provenance.cyclic: applied per-aspect on transit entries (cyclic model)
